outputs.repository: wwPDB (wwPDB deposition portal) / (related to PDB/EMDB deposition system)
outputs.justification: The manuscript points to the wwPDB deposition site but does not provide a direct, public dataset record or an accession identifier/landing page. deposit-2.wwpdb.org is the deposition/submit portal (used to upload data) rather than a public data-record URL; it typically requires a specific accession or a depositor-mediated public link (and may require authentication). As given, the link does not resolve to a public dataset page where the paper's source data can be directly accessed.
